player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id}. Wo reko Guess The Number.
Wo hiaa wo nsaanoa koko no mu {min_number} ne {max_number} mu {max_turns} nsaanoa mu.
Se wo de wo nsaanoa koko no mu, agoro no beboa wo nkyerɛkyerɛmu te sɛ 'kɔ soro' anaa 'kɔ fam'.
Wo betumi de wo mmuaeɛ biara. Nsaanoa koko no a wɔde ato square brackets mu no na wɔbɛgye no sɛ wo nsaanoa. Sɛ nhwɛso, [5].
Se wo reko no, wo nsaanoa abakɔsɛm no beboa wo ase. Fa mfonyini no so wo nsaanoa no ansa na wo nsaanoa no ayɛ pɛ.
De wo nsaanoa koko no mu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nkyerɛwdeɛ a ɛyɛ mũ a wɔde yɛɛ mu nsɛm no nnyɛ papa. Ogyefo {player_id} antumi ankyerɛ '[number]' a ɛyɛ papa.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nkyerεmu a enni mu. Agorɔfoɔ {player_id} kaa nɔma bi wɔ baabi foforo wͻ beae no so.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Akwan a enni mu. Agorɔfoɔ {player_id} adi kan aka nɔma no dedaw.

game_message.target_higher: Adwene a wɔde sii wɔn ani so no dɔɔso.
game_message.target_lower: Nsaanoa a wɔpɛ no kɔ fam.

outcome.win: W'ani agye! Woaka akontaabu no yiye.
outcome.turn_limit: Nsaanoa koko no awieeɛ. Nsaanoa: {guess}, Botaeɛ: {target}
